value.rationale: A physically natural time-series question—minimal observed order needed to expose the nonequilibrium time arrow—is resolved uniformly for an entire random marked contraction family. Ordinary spatial symmetry and the covariance conceal orientation; a fourth-order observable has an explicit strict sign at every lag and a unique sharp optimal lag.
